ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
en: (1) Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
tr: Qul ūḥiya ilayya annahustamaʿa nafarum minal-jinni faqālū innā samiʿnā qurʾānan ʿajabā

ar: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
en: (2) It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
tr: Yahdī ilar-rushdi faʾāmannā bih, walan nushrika birabbinā aḥadā

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
en: (3) And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
tr: Waʾannahū taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mattakhadha ṣāḥibataw walā waladā

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
en: (4) And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees][1766] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
enNotes: [1766]- A plural form may also be understood, i.e., "the foolish ones among us."
tr: Waʾannahū kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalallāhi shaṭaṭā

ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
en: (5) And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.
tr: Waʾannā ẓanannā al lan taqūlal-insu wal-jinnu ʿalallāhi kadhibā

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
en: (6) And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
tr: Waʾannahū kāna rijālum minal-insi yaʿūdhūna birijālim minal-jinni fazādūhum rahaqā

ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
en: (7) And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
tr: Waʾannahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum al lay yabʿathallāhu aḥadā

ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
en: (8) And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
tr: Waʾannā lamasnas-samāʾa fawajadnāhā muliʾat ḥarasan shadīdaw washuhubā

ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
en: (9) And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing,[1767] but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
enNotes: [1767]- Before the prophethood of Muḥammad (ﷺ) the jinn used to collect information by eavesdropping on the angels and then pass it on to fortunetellers and soothsayers.
tr: Waʾannā kunnā naqʿudu minhā maqāʿida lis-samʿ, famay yastamiʿil-āna yajid lahū shihābar raṣadā

ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
en: (10) And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
tr: Waʾannā lā nadrī asharrun urīda biman fil-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rashadā

ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
en: (11) And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.[1768]
enNotes: [1768]- In opinion, belief and religious practice.
tr: Waʾannā minnaṣ-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālik, kunnā ṭarāʾiqa qidadā

ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
en: (12) And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
tr: Waʾannā ẓanannā al lan nuʿjizallāha fil-arḍi walan nuʿjizahū harabā

ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
en: (13) And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.[1769]
enNotes: [1769]- In regard to his account in the Hereafter. Nothing of his good will be diminished, nor will the evil of another be placed upon him.
tr: Waʾannā lammā samiʿnal-hudā āmannā bih, famay yuʾmim birabbihī falā yakhāfu bakhsaw walā rahaqā

ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
en: (14) And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust.[1770] And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
enNotes: [1770]- i.e., those who deviate from the truth and act tyrannically.
tr: Waʾannā minnal-muslimūna waminnal-qāsiṭūn, faman aslama faʾulāʾika taḥarraw rashadā

ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
en: (15) But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
tr: Waʾammal-qāsiṭūna fakānū lijahannama ḥaṭabā

ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
en: (16) And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision]
tr: Waʾal lawistaqāmū ʿalaṭ-ṭarīqati laʾasqaynāhum māʾan ghadaqā

ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
en: (17) So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord[1771] He will put into arduous punishment.
tr: Linaftinahum fīh, wamay yuʿriḍ ʿan dhikri rabbihī yaslukhu ʿadhāban ṣaʿadā

ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
en: (18) And [He revealed] that the masjids[1772] are for Allāh, so do not invoke[1773] with Allāh anyone.
enNotes:
[1772]- The term "masjid" here includes every place of worship or the earth in general.
[1773]- Or "worship."
tr: Waʾannal-masājida lillāhi falā tadʿū maʿallāhi aḥadā

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
en: (19) And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."[1774]
enNotes: [1774]- Crowding on top of each other in the manner of locusts in order to hear him (ﷺ). "They" may refer to the jinn or to the disbelievers among the Arabs.
tr: Waʾannahū lammā qāma ʿabdullāhi yadʿūhu kādū yakūnūna ʿalayhi libadā

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
en: (20) Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
tr: Qul innamā adʿū rabbī walā ushriku bihī aḥadā

ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
en: (21) Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
tr: Qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarraw walā rashadā

ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
en: (22) Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
tr: Qul innī lay yujīranī minallāhi aḥaduw walan ajida min dūnihī multaḥadā

ar: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
en: (23) But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
tr: Illā balāgham minallāhi warisālātih, wamay yaʿṣillāha warasūlahū faʾinna lahū nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadā

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
en: (24) [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
tr: Ḥattā idhā raʾaw mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man aḍʿafu nāṣiraw waʾaqallu ʿadadā

ar: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
en: (25) Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
tr: Qul in adrī aqarībum mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahū rabbī amadā

ar: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
en: (26) [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
tr: ʿĀlimul-ghaybi falā yuẓhiru ʿalā ghaybihī aḥadā

ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
en: (27) Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers[1775]
enNotes: [1775]- Guardian angels to protect the messenger and the message.
tr: Illā manirtaḍā mir rasūlin faʾinnahū yasluku mim bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihī raṣadā

ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
en: (28) That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know[1776] that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
enNotes: [1776]- This phrase may also be read: "So He [i.e., Allāh] may make evident."
tr: Liyaʿlama an qad ablaghū risālāti rabbihim waʾaḥāṭa bimā ladayhim waʾaḥṣā kulla shayʾin ʿadadā
